Name: Diverse Shane (Content Patcher)
Author: SylverScourge
Description:
[size=3]  [u][b]Note - [/b]This mod currently has compatibility issues with UI mods. If anyone knows how to fix it, it would be epic if you could DM me and help. [/u](SylverScourge, I'm in the SDV discord server and my DMs are open)


I don't really have any explanation on why I made this mod. I just randomly started giving Shane darker skin in my art so I figured why not put that in the game! The portraits were made from scratch by me so they're not perfect but I tried my best.[/size]

[size=3]  I heavily referenced [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Slightly Cuter Characters[/url][size=3] for the sprites so they would match since I really like that mod. I recommend using it alongside this one. I did some testing and it shouldn't conflict with any mods as long as those mods also aren't trying to alter Shane in any way (it should override SCC). [/size]

[size=3]  [/size][u]Recommended mods
[/u][size=2]My [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10757]Shane's Room Redesigned[/url] mod!
[/size][b]Non-Alcoholic Shane [/b](If what's keeping you away from this cutie is the alcoholism): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8729
[b]Immersive Shane[/b] (I didn't do joja portraits. Compatible if you just let Shane work in peace!): https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/487802-immersive-characters-shane



[size=3]  [/size][u]Future Plans[/u][size=3] (unrelated to the mod)[/size]
I intend on eventually making Marnie and Jas to match! That may take a very long time though. I spent like a month on this one. 
I intent on making an extension for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11141]Catboy Pierre[/url] called "Catdew Valley" which may take years at this rate.
I'm also currently working on a ﻿HD portrait mod for all characters!

Downloads.Description: Unzip and drop into your mods folder. Should load perfectly alongside SCC.
